title: Golden hour: photo sky, low warm sun, long shadows
summary: Drop-in outdoor lighting: real photographed sunset sky (Poly Haven HDR, sun-aligned), warm sun 13 deg above the horizon, long blue-grey shadows, warm haze and soft glow.
use_when: Any outdoor 3D game that should look cinematic or realistic in the first shot: sunset, golden hour, late afternoon, warm, beautiful, photo-real sky.
how_to_use: Instance res://starter/look-golden-hour/look.tscn ONCE as a child of the main 3D scene root (it is a Node3D at the origin; leave it unscaled). It contains WorldEnvironment (environment res://starter/look-golden-hour/env.tres) and a DirectionalLight3D named 'Sun'. The look's script (look_rig.gd, take_over=true) hands its Environment to any other WorldEnvironment and hides every DirectionalLight3D outside the look at runtime, so you do not have to delete old defaults (set take_over=false on the look root to keep your own sun). Do NOT rotate the 'Sun' node: the photographed sun in the HDR is aligned to rotation (-13, -145) deg; to change which way the sunset faces, turn your level instead. env.tres is tuned for the Compatibility renderer; Forward+ values live in the look root's forward_plus_overrides. Sun: colour (1, 0.76, 0.49), energy 1.6, shadows to 80 m. Camera looking toward -X/-Z faces the sun (backlit, most dramatic); shadows fall toward +X/+Z. The sky below the horizon is a warm haze, so a ground plane of any size works.

contents.what: Environment: photo sky, sky ambient 0.75, Filmic, glow 0.85 threshold, warm exponential fog 0.0032
sky shader: HDR panorama rotated to the sun, ground haze ramp, sun glare

scale: no geometry; place at the origin

verified.notes: demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ on macOS (Metal, 1280x720) with no SCRIPT ERROR or shader errors; fresh_test (clean cloud project + preview stage) imports and renders in Compatibility with no errors. Not run in a real browser (WebGL2) or on the cloud's Linux/Mesa GL. Compatibility and Forward+ look nearly identical. Volumetric fog from the source replaced by exponential fog. Fresh test shows the look taking over the stage's own WorldEnvironment/sun. v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
